items.title: Billy McBride and Mary McBride ("Mack and Mack") Interview, 1959-07-01
items.q: He traveled with us for a while.

ctx.x: He traveled with us for a while. Oh, he did? Well, I didn't clap, Freddie Keppard, yes.
I never knew him, but I know his brother is still living there, a very nice guitar player. He plays guitar. Louis Keppard.
